verdict.rationale: Supermemory is a memory API/platform whose documented MCP role is as the *server* that other AI assistants plug into for memory tools (docs-11, docs-35, probe-rt-1) — not an agent that itself consumes external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence Supermemory acts as an MCP client integrating third-party tool servers, and this role doesn't fit its product category.
